about: Story mode's bottles (docs/loop/items/I-053/spec.md section 5): the codex substance each pack item supplies to a discovered spell. Air supplies its gases free. In the block world a cast of a discovered spell needs a bottle of every reactant and uses up one of each item marked consumed; free play (the Chemistry Bench page) has unlimited bottles. `find` says in plain words where the player gets the item: the missing-bottle caption and the pack show it. Charcoal comes before coal: it is the carbon the story gives (the charcoal clamp), and coal is the alternative.

items.find: Heat wood with very little air: cast Fire into the vent on the charcoal mound (Frozen Fields). When the smoke clears, press E there.
Coal works just like charcoal, if you already have some.
Snow covers the Frozen Fields. Point the Pick (key 5) at snowy ground and hold the mouse to scoop some up.
Iron is hard to find in this valley. Try a spell that uses charcoal instead.

items.why: the valley's iron ore is haematite, Fe2O3
items.find: A few rusty brown blocks hide in the rock under the charcoal mound. The Pick (key 5) can pick one up.
Sand lines the river bed at the ford. Point the Pick (key 5) at it and hold the mouse to scoop some up.

items.why: a flask of oxygen; a cast takes a little
items.find: Run the water-splitting rig in the cave (press E there). Each run fills an O2 flask and an H2 balloon.
